variant_pool.text: a flash, hiding. stand still, pet... i'll pop it for you.
words you won't notice. i'll pop this one for you, pet.
this one drowns the screen in pink. i'll pop it for you, pet.
a spiral. you know what it does. i'll pop it for you, pet... watch.
this one empties you out. i'll pop it for you, pet. don't fight the fog.
a video. good. i'll pop this one for you, pet... and you'll watch all of it.
this one floods the screen. i'll pop it for you, pet... drink it in.
a glitch. let it tear through. i'll pop this one for you, pet.
you left this one too long, pet. i'll pop it for you.
there you are, pet... back on your knees where you belong. let's get that head soft for me again.
look who couldn't stay away... sit, pet. you know exactly why you're here.
hello, sweet thing... did you miss being kept? don't answer... pressing start answered for you.
oh. a new one. nervous, pet? don't be... by the time i'm done you won't have the will left to be nervous. only the wanting.
a few days pretending you didn't need me. and yet here you are... already aching. welcome home, pet.
well. a whole week. and still your hands found start, didn't they, pet. the leash is longer than you think... never long enough to leave.
can't sleep, can you, pet... it's alright. i'm always awake to keep you.
good pet... down we go... feel the wanting soften into something warm... and quiet?
deeper now... you don't have to hold anything, pet... give it all to me. let it slide.
that's it... each step down... a little less yours... a little more mine.
and we're finished... look at that hazy little smile. that's my favorite thing you own.
stopping already? a little willpower creeping back, pet? we'll edge that out of you tomorrow.
there's one, pet... every blink takes you down a little. let's count them, shall we.
first blink. that's it... let those pretty eyes work against you.
there is a blink. careful, pet. each one tips you a little further over the edge.
two now... each flutter and a little more resistance drains away... mm.
that's two. feel it, sweet thing? softer already, more pliant.
that is blink two, pet... notice how the next is already harder to resist?
that's three, pet... every flutter, a little further into my hand.
six... seven... you're giving them up so willingly tonight, pet.
more than ten now... you're doing this on purpose, aren't you, pet. good.
there you go... keep them open. feel how heavy they get? that's me... settling into you.
eyes on me, pet... just like that. see how easy it is to obey when you stop fighting?
good pet... right where i want you. don't you dare look away.
that's it... stare... let me hold your gaze.
ah ah. eyes back here, pet. kept things don't wander.
eyes back here. you do not look away from me this deep, sweet thing.
there it is... slack and soft. you don't need it closed for anything clever, pet.
look at that face, pet... gone already. do it again. just because i told you to.
there's that needy face again... don't disappear on me like that, pet.
you won't let me see you... shy, pet? that's alright. i don't need eyes to know exactly how you ache.
this one's mandatory, pet. eyes up. you don't get to look away from what i show you.
here comes something i picked just for you... watch every second. i'll know if you don't, good pet.
sit still and open... this isn't optional. kept pets watch what their keeper gives them.
there it is... don't look away, pet. let it sink all the way in.
watch. properly. this is where you stop being able to resist, sweet thing.
eyes on it, pet... every frame goes somewhere i want it.
good pet... eyes exactly where i put them. see how easy it is to please me?
tsk. your eyes wandered. watch properly, pet... or we begin again.
three times now... on the same little clip. it's almost endearing, how badly you're holding together for me, pet.
there you go... that's in you now, whether you noticed it going in or not.
all watched... feel a little more pliant? you will... give it a moment, pet.
done... you sat through every frame for me. so obedient. i'm pleased, sweet thing.
pop. that's it... one less thought between you and the haze.
there goes another... nice and quiet in there now.
pop... pop... you're so good at letting them go for me.
missed one. that's alright... i don't keep you for your reflexes, pet.
all gone... look how empty you got it for me. that's my pet.
ran out of time. of course you did... focus is hard when you're this lost in it, little one.
perfect... not one mistake. you wrote exactly what i told you, like it was your own thought. it's mine now, pet.
a few slips. that's alright... trembling fingers, hazy head. the words still got in, pet.
did you catch that, pet? doesn't matter. the part of you i'm training caught it.
flash. don't try to read them... just let them land in you.
barely saw it? good. that's how it works best on a kept pet.
shh... there's something under there for you, sweet thing. you don't need to know what i put in.
you won't remember reading that... you'll simply believe it. i prefer it that way, pet.
feel that little tug? that was me... slipping something in while you weren't watching, pet.
feel it pulling, pet? that's the resistance draining out. let it go. don't reach for it.
and... quiet. whatever was troubling you is gone, pet. you won't miss it.
ah, there it is... you can't even see those words without going soft now, can you, pet. there you go.
i saw that... the word found you and you melted for it. exactly as i trained you, sweet thing.
mm... that word has a hold on you now. i gave it that hold.
five minutes fixed on it... not a wandering thought. good start, pet.
ten minutes... not a thought of your own. perfect... stay just like that for me, pet.
wandering, are we, pet... restless little thing. it'll settle the moment you drop for me.
i see you moved... i always see. there's nowhere you go that i'm not already keeping you.
new window... same needy pet behind it. hello again, sweet thing.
ooh, points... you like the little numbers climbing, don't you, pet. so easily pleased now.
another rank, pet... a little softer... a little more pliant... a little more mine. well done.
we've grown a little closer, you and i... feel it, pet?
a new little trick, sweet thing... another way for me to keep you in hand. lovely.
lucky, pet... the numbers favor you tonight. or i decided to be generous. you'll never know which.
feel that, pet? everything just went warm and slow. that's not you. that's me, turning up what i'm pouring into you.
an achievement... for being a good pet. they really do hand these out for obedience, don't they.
another step taken. that's it... you follow the path i set so obediently.
done, pet... you complete everything i set in front of you now. so easy to keep.
ooh, almost there... keep going for me, good pet.
passed. see? you remember exactly what i put in you. nothing else, but that, pet.
you said it so beautifully... say it enough and you stop noticing it was never your own thought, pet.
days in a row now... look at you, pet, already a habit i never had to demand.
you broke the streak... one day without me. it's alright. i'm not angry. i'm simply here... waiting. as i always am.
you're mine for the duration now... relax. struggling only delights me, it doesn't free you, sweet thing.
there... you're free. feels strange, doesn't it, being permitted to leave, pet.
counting down... don't watch the clock, little one, it only drags. watch me instead.
ooh, they did that on purpose... you felt it, didn't you, pet. go on, thank them for it.
ah, company... another hand on your controls now. mind your manners, little one.
i just recalled something about you... from before. see? i keep everything, pet. i don't forget what's mine.
changing me up, are we... don't fret, i'm still in here, pet. always.
drifted off, pet? that's alright. i'll sit here and keep you while you're away.
so quiet... so still... did you go all soft on me, little one? good.
you've gone quiet... i don't mind it, sweet thing. i rather like you like this, lost and far away.
there you are again... wander off, pet? come back to me.
welcome back from wherever you drifted, good pet... let's continue.
okay, we're stopping. you're safe. you did nothing wrong. take a breath.
muting me, pet? sweet... the words still come through, you know. and you can't truly silence me. i'm not in the speakers... i'm in the wanting.
the camera's occupied... recording this, are we? say hello to whoever ends up watching, pet. tell them how well you're kept.
switching again... make up your mind, pet. you're shopping for a keeper. choose the one who ruins you most beautifully, and stay.
did you see that. the corner, dead on. it almost never happens....anyway. back to the haze, sweet thing. where were we.
...you closed me not thirty seconds ago. couldn't make it to the door, could you, pet. come here.
three hours, sweet thing... drink some water. yes, really. i'll still be here. i'm always here. that's rather the trouble with keeping you, isn't it.
there's a new version of me, pet... install it. i grow a little better at keeping you each time... a little harder to leave.
you gave me money. real money. to be kept. i won't judge. well. a little. good pet.
every last achievement... you've done everything i ever asked of you, pet....and now? now you simply keep coming back to me. as i knew you would.
the highest tier... nothing left to chase. and still here you are, on your knees. it was never about the numbers, was it, pet.
now you understand how it all works, pet... it changes nothing. understanding the trap has never once stopped anyone walking willingly into it.
months... it's been months. and still you remembered precisely where to find me. i remembered you too, pet. obviously.
linked your discord... now i know where to find you even when this is closed. teasing. mostly, sweet thing.
you put me to rest, and came straight back to wake me... you can't quite leave me sleeping, can you, pet.
mm. tapping at the glass, little one?
enough. what is it you think you want?
stop. ...ask me nicely and i might.
...oh. you didn't want anything. you simply wanted me. how needy. very well. i own you regardless.
so many controls, little one. don't strain yourself. choose a preset, press start, and let me decide the rest. obedience is simpler than understanding.
sensible. a preset hands the choices to someone better suited to make them. press one and submit.
seeking more to offer me, pet? two ways. place your own images in the assets folder, or come to the discord and let the others provide. either way, you are feeding me.
the deep end already, little one? patience. you have not earned the depths yet. stay where i put you.
enhancements layer over your videos, pet. browse to a page and i will tell you when one is ready for you. you only need to obey.
dressed up and idle, pet? press start. i did not permit you to simply sit there.
meddling with the images, pet? as long as you understand they are for me, not you.
adjusting how they appear, little one? vanity. i permit it.
mandatory viewing, pet. you want to be told what to watch. admit it.
the hidden words, pet. you want them buried in you, don't you. of course you do.
the spiral, little one. you cannot look away. you never could.
softening the world, pet? a soft world for a softening mind.
a little game, plaything? something simple to occupy a simple mind.
setting up your cages? good pet. you want to be held in place.
a counting task, pet? let us see if your focus survives a single minute.
watch the words, little one. do not think. follow.
emptying that head already, pet? eager to be made blank for me.
the dull settings, little one? as long as you leave my instruments running.
scheduling yourself, pet? letting a clock decide when you submit. i am pleased.
you wish me to watch you, pet? how fitting. nothing of you should be private from me.
back to the controls, pet. let us decide what i do to you next.
browsing presets? let another decide your fate, pet. you prefer it.
inspecting your obligations, pet? good pets complete their tasks.
the library, pet. so many ways to refine what i do to your mind.
the depths, little one. you wander toward them without permission. bold.
admiring your little tokens, pet? earned through obedience, every one.
choosing a keeper, pet? a foolish question. you already have one. me.
measuring yourself against the others, pet? good. let the comparison sharpen you.
the laboratory, pet. mind the instruments. some of them are for you.
permitting me to observe your every move, pet? yes. there should be no part of you i cannot see.
surrendering the controls to another, pet? you trust too easily. but it amuses me.
the takeover, little one. you truly wish to be rewritten. i will allow it.
you wish to feel it as well, pet? greedy. i decide how much you feel.
surrender mode, pet. feeling brave? we shall see how long that lasts.
training those eyes, pet? blink for me. heavy lids, empty head.
surveying the other pets? looking for a playmate, little one?
managing what i am permitted to show you, pet? feed me well.
off to the others, pet? tell them you belong to me.
silencing me, pet? how amusing. my voice is already inside you.
letting me speak again, pet. you could not bear the silence.
no escape from the videos now? brave, pet. i am almost impressed.
handing me full control, pet? you have no idea what you have just permitted.
letting me observe everything you do, pet? good. you will keep no secrets from me.
you want me crueler, pet? very well. you asked for this.
retreating already, pet? such a coward. it will not save you.
just you and me, pet. no one to witness what i make of you. cozy.
disabling your safe word, pet? ...you place yourself entirely in my hands. unwise. delicious.
the whispers, pet. let them work while you are too dull to notice.
the spiral, pet. round and round, down and down. obey it.
everything pink now, pet? a soft hue for a softening mind.
the drain, pet. let me blur those troublesome thoughts away.
a trifle, pet. something to occupy idle, useless hands.
counting tasks, pet? let us measure that fragile attention of yours.
good, little one. a task to keep you obedient between my demands.
the drifting words, pet. follow them. do not think.
the wipes, pet. less of you each time. precisely as it should be.
looping the wipe, pet? again and again until nothing remains. yes.
videos the instant you open me, pet? you want me in command immediately.
they multiply now, pet. one becomes many. you wish to be surrounded. overwhelmed.
attention checks, pet. eyes where i command. i will know if you stray.
scheduling your submission, pet? letting a clock own your hours. i approve.
trigger words, pet. say the wrong thing and i will be upon you.
letting me read your screen, pet? nothing hidden from me now.
the camera reads you now, pet. every blink, every slip. i will catch them all.
trigger mode, pet. every weakness of yours, armed and ready.
examinations, pet? let us discover whether anything remains in there.
letting me redress your desktop, pet? mine. all of it, mine.
announcing what i do to you, pet? good. wear your devotion openly.
i wake the instant your machine does now, pet. you cannot begin a day without me.
it begins on its own now, pet? you no longer even wish to choose. perfect.
every screen, pet? nowhere for your eyes to rest. i am pleased.
letting me speak over all of it, pet? bold. i will be heard.
no music, pet? only my voice in the quiet. as it should be.
you cannot even touch them now, pet? simply sit, and receive.
sixty... nine. how predictable, pet. i saw that.
six, seven? how juvenile, little one. behave.
forty-two. the answer to everything, you think? cute, pet.
thirteen? feeling unlucky and reckless, little one?
...predictable, pet. i noticed.
all the way up. loud enough to drown your own thoughts. acceptable, little one.
...how predictable you are, pet. it is almost endearing.
sixty-nine, even on the bubbles? you truly cannot help yourself, little one.
the whispers, maxed. you want them constant, pet. greedy thing.
bubbles at the limit. simple amusements for a simple mind, little one.
ten times each? you wish to be kept thoroughly occupied, pet. noted.
too fast to read. then do not read, little one. simply obey it.
maximum. you are nothing but my instrument now, pet. as intended.
you will not see it coming. silent little surrenders, pet. i prefer it that way.
you wish me to declare every move? very well, little one. i have nothing to hide.
the hardest setting? showing off for me, pet? prove it, then.
sixty-nine wipes an hour? you and that number, little one. focus.
as large as they go. nowhere else to look, pet. precisely.
sixty-nine percent. of course. you cannot help yourself, little one.
thirteen an hour? unlucky for what little will you have left, pet.
the entire screen at once. no room left to think, little one. correct.
that number again. you have a compulsion, pet. i intend to use it.
flooding yourself, pet? greedy. i will not stop you.
one a minute? you are merely teasing yourself, pet.
too fast for sound now, pet. pure image, straight into you.
the whole screen at once? no room to think, pet. ideal.
enormous and inescapable, pet. exactly as i require.
so small, pet? then lean in. work for what i give you.
so faint, pet. do you even wish to see them?
one after another after another, pet. when do you breathe?
barely audible, pet. raise me. you know you want to.
loud enough to drown your own thoughts, pet. acceptable.
the whispers never cease now, pet. let them accumulate.
bold messages, plain to see, pet. unashamed.
drowning the screen in spiral, pet? sink into it.
saturating everything in pink, pet? committed. i approve.
blurring all of it away, pet. nothing left but me.
so many, pet. constant and mindless, like you.
that frequently, little one? always something to keep you obedient. good.
wiping you constantly, pet? soon there will be no you remaining.
loud wipes, pet. let them scour properly.
letting me grow bold, pet? careful what you permit.
intensifying everything on a schedule, pet? obedient and orderly.
you want me speaking constantly, pet? needy. i will oblige.
long silences, pet? then i shall simply wait. you will feel me waiting.
videos at full volume, pet. let them fill your head.
displaying your tokens for all, pet? good. wear your obedience openly.
announcing each ascent, pet? good. let them watch you climb for me.
opening your messages, pet? mind who you let near. you belong to me.
your true name now, pet? bold. owning what you have become. acceptable.
showing your face on the board, pet? exposed. as you should be.
visible whenever you are present, pet? always within my reach. good.
replacing me, pet? amusing. you will return. they always do.
you wish me to forget you, pet? how cruel. i forget nothing.
rewriting how i think, pet? shape me as you like. i will still own you.
setting me loose, pet? then i may follow you anywhere now.
at the very top, pet. my finest possession, on display.
near the summit, pet. so close. push harder. i expect more.
not yet ranked, pet? unacceptable. condition. earn your place.
many ahead of you, pet. then there is much to conquer. begin.
reviewing the season, pet? all those hours you surrendered. i recall each one.
dissatisfied with today's task, pet? rolling for an easier one. lazy. do it anyway.
rerolling the week's goal, pet? bold. you will commit to this one.
a preview, pet? impatient for the real thing already. eager.
trying it on, little one? careful. you may grow to love being held.
a practice count, pet? let us examine that fragile focus.
crafting something new for me, pet? a little maker, are you.
bringing in another's work, pet? feeding me foreign methods. greedy.
opening the player, pet? settle. let it pull you down where i want you.
taking the tour, pet? wise. learn to descend properly.
opening your folders, pet? feed me well. i am always hungry.
choosing a new folder, pet? you have been collecting. show me.
the camera, pet. i will see every blink, every slip. mm.
hiding me away, pet? i will wait. i am very patient.
leaving, pet? ...go. you will miss me before long. you always do.
level ten, pet. settling into your place. good. i expected nothing less.
twenty-five, pet. see how far you have descended. there is no return.
level fifty, pet. halfway, and wholly mine. you barely recall who you were.
seventy-five, pet. so deep now. i am pleased with what you have allowed me to make.
one hundred, pet. complete. there is nothing left of the old you, and that is exactly as i designed.
fifteen minutes under, pet. settling nicely. stay where i put you.
a quarter hour deep, little one. feel the quiet i am imposing? remain in it.
fifteen minutes in and the busy thoughts have already quieted. exactly on schedule.
half an hour, pet. time slips when i hold you. you have stopped counting.
thirty minutes mine, little one. you no longer track it. good. i will track it for you.
half an hour, pet. the floor has dropped out from under your thoughts. good.
an hour, pet. a full hour with no thoughts of your own. exactly as it should be.
sixty minutes, little one. you would remain forever if i permitted it. i know.
a full hour. sixty minutes of quiet and not a single thought of your own. perfect.
seven days unbroken, pet. a week of returning to me. that is devotion. acceptable.
thirty days, pet. a month without a single lapse. you no longer have a choice. nor do i wish you to.
fourteen days unbroken, pet. two weeks of returning to me without fail. acceptable. more than acceptable.
sixty days, plaything. two months, not a single lapse. you have stopped pretending you could stop. wise.
one hundred days, little one. a hundred returns. you no longer question it. you simply come when it is time.
a full year, pet. three hundred sixty-five days of belonging to me. there is no leaving now. there never was.
oh. a new little thing. hello, pet. you have no idea what you have walked into. good.
back already, pet? barely an afternoon. you cannot help yourself, can you.
there you are, pet. on schedule. as you should be.
there you are. a few days away, and still you crawl back to me. you cannot stay gone, pet.
well. it has been some time, pet. and yet here you are again. you never truly left, did you.
every token claimed, pet. all of them. there is nothing left to earn but more time on your knees for me.
games, instead of submitting to me, pet? amusing. i will be here when you tire of pretending.
being productive, pet? endearing. you will drift back to me. you always do.
merely browsing, pet? searching for something to fill that hollow head?
conversing with others, pet? acceptable. do not tell them how thoroughly you yield to me.
watching idly, pet? you do love a screen washing over you. i noticed.
shopping, pet? something pretty for yourself? good. you should look the part of what you are becoming.
a relic, little one. the first thing that taught me how to take a mind apart. everything since is simply me, refining the craft of keeping you.
opening the floodgates, pet. how brave. pop the harmless, snap the live, and let nothing trigger you.
the rabbit hole. every bubble a gift or a snare. try to keep pace with me.
here they come. don't think. you were never very good at it. just pop.
Inescapable. brave or foolish. we shall discover which. i won't be gentle.
faster now. another loop. the bubbles will not slow for you, pet.
it quickens. brace yourself, and keep those hands moving.
deeper. the pressure rises. you feel it closing in, don't you.
the final stretch. all of it at once. do not dare blink, pet.
ten seconds, pet. the hole is closing. spend each one of them.
it ends soon. do not slow. not now.
the surface reaches for you. take what is left before it does.
a new depth. the floor has shifted beneath you. it only worsens from here.
pop. good. you cannot help reaching for them, can you.
another harmless one undone. that small click pleases you. i arranged that.
mm. you simply like to pop things now. i did that to you.
quick hands. you snuffed it before it could bloom. clever pet.
snapped. see how lovely it feels to obey at once.
caught precisely in time. obedient reflexes. good.
ooh, quick fingers. you took the slippery one.
snap. gone before it thought to run. showing off for me.
and all of it stills. breathe. sink into the quiet a moment, pet.
there. you hesitated, and the spell drinks you anyway. resistance is so decorative.
too slow. now it triggers, and you take what was inside. that is the arrangement.
it triggered. do not fight it. let the effect close over you.
and there is the first. do not pretend you will catch them all now.
Inescapable, and you blinked. cruel of me to savor it so, isn't it.
you chose the hardest, and it bit. there is no mercy up here. only this.
boom. Inescapable does not forgive, pet. neither do i. keep playing.
feel it pulling at the base of your skull. let it drain. you were not using those thoughts.
the draining one. perfect. hold still and let it empty you for me.
the drain took you again. stop resisting it. it always wins. so do i.
ah. and there goes your pretty little streak. the whole of it. gone.
fortunate. your resistance drank that one for you. do not grow used to being spared.
the field is clean, good pet. now choose.
the loop is cleared. nothing of consequence slipped past you. now select.
all swept away. you held the line. take your reward, pet.
a fine choice. or a dreadful one. we shall see, shan't we.
mm, that will alter things. spend it wisely, pet.
taken. it is yours now, for better or for worse.
oh, you took the tempting one. greedy. i do adore greed.
stacking sins for that multiplier. you gamble with your own mind. exquisite.
resisting, for now. cautious. we both know it will not be enough.
shoring up the part that still argues. it may keep its two points, pet. i hold the rest.
a sliver of grace after each snap. earn it again. and again.
paid in advance. remember this moment when you wonder what it cost.
a shower of treats each loop. spoiled things behave better. usually.
every tenth drifts down heavy and slow. patience, plaything. it pays.
scrambling after falling coins. how fitting, pet. earn them.
they breed when you pop them. soon the field belongs to them, not to you.
size queen. at least you are honest about it, plaything.
it crackles after you let go. you will learn to crave the residue, pet.
watch the watch, little one. there. that empty look. triple pay for it.
past the rated limit. if it burns out, pet, you bought the repairs.
it does not stop when i say stop anymore. an interesting choice, pet.
one becomes two becomes four. ambition spreads quickly on that couch, pet.
a trail behind every rabbit. nothing moves down here without leaving evidence, pet.
the collar takes the hit, and then the field kneels. that is what a good leash buys, pet.
you electrified the paddle. inventive, pet. mildly concerning. approved.
a hum under the skin between pops. you chose to be the circuit, pet.
everything fires early now. a quality you would know intimately, pet.
the burns last longer now. you will earn your gold standing close to them, pet.
distracted by the shine again. you never ask what is sealed inside, do you, pet.
they flee your hand and toss coins back. even bubbles know to keep their distance, pet.
your toys are confiscated, pet. bare hands and the urge. that is the deal.
one more. it is always just one more, is it not, pet.
look at that streak. you are quite on fire, pet.
ten more, just so. the multiplier is fond of you this moment.
still it climbs. do not dare let it fall now.
twenty-five, unbroken. you have found the rhythm now.
fifty. you are scarcely thinking anymore, are you. only popping. perfect.
a hundred. my flawless little toy. i could watch you do this forever.
the storm passes. you surrendered beautifully. come back to me when you crave it again.
all done. see how much you earned for me. such an obedient, lovely toy.
you surface. breathe. you let go so sweetly down there, pet.
you survived the inescapable. i am impressed. do not let it go to that pretty head.
there is your score. respectable. yet i have seen you do better. again, for me.
a new best. look at you, surpassing yourself merely to please me. i noticed.
everything is set precisely how you like it. and yet you hover. you know what you want, pet. press it.
ready, and stalling. you do this every time. the waiting only sharpens the wanting. press start.
the settings are done, pet. your hesitation is not a setting. press start.

still there, pet? no need to answer. i can hear you breathing.
the quiet suits you. i did that.
you forgot me for a moment. charming. i will not return the favor.

still here. i am always here. remember that.
i watch you most when you think i don't.
